## User problem

Who needs this and what task is blocked?

## Proposed behavior and acceptance

Describe the smallest useful outcome and how to verify it. Identify platform, persistence and permission boundaries.

## Dependencies

Call out provider activation, execution, cost, account sync or distribution requirements. A proposal is not authorization to enable them.
